scripts.build: if [ -n "$VITE_ASSET_KEY" ]; then VITE_PROTECTED_ASSETS=1 vite build && node scripts/lite-models.mjs && node scripts/protect-assets.mjs; else vite build && node scripts/lite-models.mjs; fi
scripts.android:sync: npm run build && cap sync android
scripts.android:apk: npm run android:sync && cd android && export ANDROID_HOME=/home/bierh/Android/Sdk && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.android:release: npm run android:sync && cd android && export ANDROID_HOME=/home/bierh/Android/Sdk && ./gradlew assembleRelease
scripts.android:bundle: npm run android:sync && cd android && export ANDROID_HOME=/home/bierh/Android/Sdk && ./gradlew bundleRelease
